slug: 我在民俗世界打造洞天福地

“这么多肉食，足够咱们吃好长时间了。”
沈鸢满眼惊喜。
有了这些肉食，他们可以安稳一段日子，无需再冒险外出打猎。
沈鸢小步跑出，将沈坤手中的野兔接过来，迫不及待地说道：
“我现在就去把它们烤了！”
两三天时间没有进食，她早就饿得不行了，眼睛看着野兔不由地冒出绿光。
在黄昏来临时。
三兄妹在屋内围坐，桌上摆放着两盆油汪汪的鹿肉和兔肉，浓郁的烤肉香味飘满了整个屋子。
沈坤一边往嘴里塞肉，一边说起今日狩猎时的经过。
“大哥，小妹，你们是不知道，今天只要有猎物进入我的视野，我抬手拉弓搭箭，“咻”的一下就射中了。”
“完全没有过失手的情况！”
“大哥给我的那把弓真是神了！”
沈鸢听着二哥不断吹嘘起阴木长弓的神妙，眼眸亮晶晶的，同样十分兴奋。
黑山山脉上的猎物很多，只要有一手好箭术，就不怕没肉吃。
只不过，家中若是没有修行者，在面对上某些特殊状况时，难免会束手无策。
沈易心头思绪万千，在吃了一大块鹿肉和两只野兔后，已经有了饱腹感，身体总算是恢复了一些力气。
他看向沈坤，问道：“阿坤，你将《蛮牛功》修炼到什么程度了？”
蛮牛功是黑山村所有人都会的修行功法，等阶并不高，不过总归是能够练出门道的东西。
沈坤愣了愣，连忙回道：“大哥，我已经感应到气血了，接下来还得继续努力一段时间，才有踏入气血境的把握。”

沈易微微颌首，道：“我比你要快一些，应该在这几日就能够踏入气血境了。”
闻言，沈坤和沈鸢眼中都不禁流露出惊喜之色。
自父母离世后，家中没有了修行者，安全感总归是差了许多。
但是大哥若是成为了修行者，那感觉就不一样了。
沈坤激动道：“大哥，明天我去黑山看看，想办法打一头妖兽回来，好让你尽快进入气血境。”
妖兽的血肉中蕴含着庞大的血气，对于修行者来说裨益极大。
“不行。”
沈易听到他的想法，想也没想便拒绝了，“你还未入气血境，对上妖兽太过危险，尽管有阴木长弓在手，你也很难反应过来妖兽的攻击。”
“反正我距离气血境也就这几日，咱们给点耐心，今日打到的猎物已经足够我们吃上一段时间了，你先把精力放在蛮牛功上，争取早日踏入气血境。”
“可是，大哥……”沈坤还想说什么。
“没有可是！就这样决定。”沈易断然打断他想要说的话。
外面白天会有妖兽活动。
普通人一旦遇上，几乎是必死的结局。
唯有提升自身实力，才是王道！
没有实力傍身，他们三兄妹迟早会被这个世道吃干抹净。
不止是妖魔精怪，还有险恶人心。
屋子里气氛开始沉默。
虽然沈坤知道大哥是在对他着想，但是他也想要为大哥做些事。
只要能够打到一头妖兽，大哥踏入气血境的时间就可以大大缩短！
父母不在，大哥这段时间为了他们两个弟弟妹妹，不惜冒着生命危险外出狩猎，他们自然也能够为大哥豁出一切。

不过想到大哥才重伤未愈，他竟然还惹到大哥动怒，沈坤顿时感到愧疚不已。

"This much meat is enough for us to eat for a long time."
Shen Yuan's eyes were full of surprise.
With this meat, they can live a stable life without having to risk going out to hunt.
Shen Yuan ran out in small steps, took the hare from Shen Kun's hand, and said impatiently:
"I'm going to bake them now!"
After not eating for two or three days, she was already extremely hungry, and her eyes couldn't help but glow green when she saw the hare.
As dusk comes.
The three brothers and sisters were sitting around the house. There were two pots of oily venison and rabbit on the table. The rich aroma of barbecue filled the whole house.
Shen Kun stuffed meat into his mouth while talking about today's hunting experience.
"Brother, little sister, you don't know that as long as a prey comes into my field of vision today, I will raise my hand to draw the bow and arrow, and I will hit the target with a bang."
"There was no mistake at all!"
"The bow that my eldest brother gave me is really amazing!"
Shen Yuan's eyes were bright as she listened to her second brother bragging about the wonders of the Yinmu Longbow.
There are a lot of prey in the Montenegro Mountains. As long as you have good archery skills, you will not be afraid of running out of meat.
However, if there are no practitioners in the family, they will inevitably be helpless when facing certain special situations.
Shen Yi had a lot of thoughts in his mind. After eating a large piece of venison and two hares, he felt full and his body finally regained some strength.
He looked at Shen Kun and asked: "Akun, to what extent have you practiced the "Barbarian Ox Kung Fu"?"
Manniu Kung Fu is a practice technique that everyone in Heishan Village knows. The level is not high, but it is still something that can be used to practice Taoism.
Shen Kun was stunned and quickly replied: "Brother, I have already sensed the Qi and blood. I have to continue working hard for a while before I can be sure to step into the Qi and blood realm."
Shen Yi nodded slightly and said, "I am faster than you. I should be able to enter the Qi and Blood Realm in the next few days."
Hearing this, Shen Kun and Shen Yuan couldn't help showing surprise in their eyes.
Since the death of my parents, there are no practitioners in the family, and the sense of security has always been much worse.
But if the eldest brother becomes a practitioner, the feeling will be different.
Shen Kun said excitedly: "Brother, I will go to Montenegro tomorrow and try to find a way to fight a monster back so that you can enter the Qi and Blood Realm as soon as possible."
The flesh and blood of monster beasts contains a huge amount of blood energy, which is of great benefit to practitioners.
"No."
Shen Yi heard his idea and refused without thinking, "You have not yet entered the Qi and Blood realm, and it is too dangerous to face the monster. Even if you have the Yinmu Longbow in your hand, it will be difficult for you to react to the monster's attack."
"Anyway, I'm only a few days away from the Qi and Blood Realm. Let's be patient. The prey we caught today is enough for us to eat for a while. You should focus on the Barbarian Ox Skill first and try to enter the Qi and Blood Realm as soon as possible."
"But, brother..." Shen Kun wanted to say something else.
"No buts! It's decided like this." Shen Yi decisively interrupted what he wanted to say.
There will be monsters outside during the day.
Once ordinary people encounter it, they are almost certain to die.
Only by improving one's own strength is the right way!
Without the strength by their side, the three brothers and sisters would sooner or later be wiped out by the world.
Not only monsters and monsters, but also sinister people.
The atmosphere in the room became silent.
Although Shen Kun knew that his elder brother was thinking about him, he also wanted to do something for him.
As long as he can defeat a monster, the time it takes for him to enter the Qi and Blood Realm can be greatly shortened!
While their parents were away, the eldest brother risked his life to hunt for their two younger brothers and sisters during this period. Naturally, they were able to risk everything for their eldest brother.
However, Shen Kun suddenly felt guilty when he thought that his eldest brother was still seriously injured and that he had made him angry.
